content: Relevant coursework: Data Structures (CS 400), Algorithms (CS 577), Operating Systems (CS 537), Database Management Systems (CS 564), Distributed Systems (CS 739)

work_experience.title: Software Engineering Intern
content: Designed and implemented a REST API in Go for refund status lookups, serving about 2,000 requests per minute in staging.
Wrote table-driven unit tests and integration tests against a PostgreSQL container, raising package coverage from 54% to 81%.
Added an index and rewrote a slow SQL join in the refunds query, cutting p95 latency from 420 ms to 95 ms.
Packaged the service in Docker and added a GitHub Actions pipeline that ran tests, linting and image builds on every pull request.
Added structured logs and Prometheus metrics, then built a Grafana dashboard the on-call team used to spot error spikes.
Reviewed teammates' pull requests weekly and addressed review comments on my own changes before merge.

work_experience.title: Undergraduate Software Developer
content: Refactored a 3,000-line C++ sensor module into separate classes behind an interface, which let two teammates add new sensors without touching the core loop.
Debugged an intermittent crash with gdb and AddressSanitizer, traced it to a use-after-free in a callback, and fixed it.
Kept the codebase in Git with feature branches and wrote the lab's contribution guide for branching and commit messages.

projects.name: Distributed Key-Value Store
content: Implemented a replicated key-value store in Go using the Raft consensus algorithm for CS 739.
Tested leader failover by killing nodes during writes; the cluster kept serving reads and no acknowledged writes were lost in 50 trials.
Profiled the write path with pprof and batched log appends, raising throughput from 1,800 to 4,600 writes per second.

projects.name: Course Planner Web App
content: Built a React front end and a Node.js/Express back end that lets students plan four-year course schedules.
Designed the PostgreSQL schema for courses, prerequisites and plans, and wrote the prerequisite check as a recursive SQL query.
Deployed the API on AWS Elastic Beanstalk with an RDS database; about 300 students used it during spring enrollment.
Added password hashing with bcrypt, parameterized queries and rate limiting on the login route after reading the OWASP Top 10.

projects.name: Search Autocomplete
content: Implemented a trie-based autocomplete in Java with top-k suggestions per prefix and cached hot prefixes in Redis.
Compared trie and sorted-array approaches on 1 million queries and documented the time and memory trade-offs.

projects.name: AI Pair-Programming Study
content: Used GitHub Copilot to draft test cases for a Python parsing library, then reviewed and corrected each suggestion before committing.
Measured that Copilot-drafted tests caught 3 of 5 seeded bugs, and wrote up where its suggestions were wrong.
Taught three workshops on Git and code review to about 40 first-year students.
